# Suede Universe Map

> A plain-English, live-verified map of the entire Suede Labs AI ecosystem: every site, app, and tool, what each is for, how they connect, and which link to click. Maintained by Suede Labs AI, founded by Jason Colapietro (also known as Johnny Suede).

The map reads top to bottom as an ownership spine: Jason Colapietro (the person) owns JC Investment Group LLC (the company), which operates Suede Labs AI (the brand), which ships the tools and sites below.

## Map

- [The Suede Universe Map](https://map.suedeai.ai/): Full spine, from founder to company to brand to every shipped product, plus a "which link do I click" router table.
- [Investor deck](https://map.suedeai.ai/deck/): Ecosystem investor deck.
- [Press kit](https://map.suedeai.ai/press/): Press assets and background.

## Core Suede properties

- [Suede Labs AI](https://suedeai.ai): The flagship product site.
- [suedeai.org](https://suedeai.org): Thesis, books, and investor information.
- [Suede Hub](https://hub.suedeai.ai): Live, browsable index of every shipped product.
- [Suede Docs](https://docs.suedeai.ai): Developer documentation, mirroring github.com/Suede-AI/suede-docs.
- [Founder profile](https://suedeai.ai/founder): Jason Colapietro / Johnny Suede, Founder and CEO of Suede Labs AI.

## Optional

- [Suede Scan](https://scan.suedeai.ai): AI-visibility audit for whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews can find and cite a given business.
- [Suede IP Registry](https://ip.suedeai.ai): Register creative work and receive a verifiable Rights Passport.
